statements:
theorem Shellsort.F09.fixed_shape_scale_penalty :
  forall {d : Nat} (hd : LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) d) {a b z : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) a → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) b → Eq (Shellsort.F09.shape d a b) z → (let s : Real :=
    Real.sqrt (HDiv.hDiv Shellsort.F09.c (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast d) z));
  let r : Real := HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) a) s;
  Eq (HSub.hSub (Shellsort.F09.K d a b) (Shellsort.F09.reduced d z))
    (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub r (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) r))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.F09.fixed_shape_scale_penalty_lower :
  forall {d : Nat} (hd : LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) d) {a b z t : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) a → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) b → Eq (Shellsort.F09.shape d a b) z → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1)
      t →
  (let s : Real := Real.sqrt (HDiv.hDiv Shellsort.F09.c (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast d) z));
  let r : Real := HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) a) s;
  Or (LE.le t r) (LE.le r (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) t)) → LE.le
    (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv s (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HDiv.hDiv (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub t (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) t))
    (HSub.hSub (Shellsort.F09.K d a b) (Shellsort.F09.reduced d z))) :=
  _

axiom propext {a b : Sort 0} : Iff a b → Eq a b

axiom Quot.sound.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Sort 0} {a b : α} : r a b → Eq (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk r b)

axiom Classical.choice.{u} {α : Sort u} : Nonempty α → α
